title: Grid Segment Net Yield
brief: A regional power grid is laid out as a tree of substations, where each substation connects to at most two downstream substations. Every substation has a net energy score: positive if it generates more than it draws, negative otherwise.
Operators can energise one continuous cable run, a sequence of substations joined by direct connections with no substation visited twice, and they want the run with the best total score.

Implement bestRouteYield(root), where root is the TreeNode for the substation at the top of the tree and each node's value is its net energy score, and return the largest total score any such run can achieve.
